title: Good Idea, Disappointing Implementation
text:
Good Idea, Disappointing Implementation. [[VIDEOID:71f3ca72ac6e53b145a8a3a9b6b43d71]] Sometimes I receive a product that is so amazing and so innovative that I end up buying it again and again. Other times I get products that I do not like but cannot find fault with them beyond preferences. Still other times I find myself with a product that just doesn’t work well. Unfortunately, this is one of those products that seems like a neat idea but doesn’t fit the need very well.

I will start by saying that I received one defective unit in the twin pack. That’s all right – I am not basing my review on the defective unit as it is an exception. I speak about this in my video and I show the problem. But – please realize that the defect is the exception, not the rule, and I am reviewing the non-defective unit.

The concept is simple – put coffee in the basket, seal it up and drop it in hot water and steep like you’re making tea. This is a good concept and in theory would work well, except that the sliding lid leaves a gap so that some of the grounds escape into the water, leaving some grit in the bottom of the cup. This could have been remedied with a small gasket between the basket and lid.

I will confess to being disappointed in this product. It does not work well for me and I cannot in good conscience recommend it for coffee drinkers. It is a better fit for tea, but it is marketed for coffee specifically.

Disclosure: I was provided a sample of this product in exchange for a fair, honest and thorough review. Even though I received this product at minimal or no cost I have rated and reviewed this product without bias, based solely on my experience with it.

product_metadata.title: AFL Products Fantastic Value Tea Strainer, Herb Infuser And Coffee Filters, 2 x Single Cup Coffee/Tea Filter For Coarse Coffee Or Loose Tea Leaves
features: Coffee and tea leaf filter: Filter for coarse ground coffee (not fine ground) or loose tea leaves for delicious hot drinks on the go
Filter coffee/tea in seconds: One cup of coffee in seconds, when you only need one cup instead of a whole batch
Plastic handle: This reusable coffee filter has a plastic handle long enough for use with up to approximately a 16oz cup
Simple to use: Simply take coarse ground coffee or loose leaf tea, fill single cup filter, slide lid closed, tap to remove excess
Light and small: Alongside a travel manual coffee grinder makes a light portable coffee making kit
description: Reusable single cup filter for coarse ground coffee and loose tea leaves enjoy coarse ground coffee at work, camping or on the go? Want fresh loose leaf tea wherever you want, whenever you want? Spending $$$ on paper coffee filters you throw away? Want to save space of a bulky coffee/tea maker? Introducing the AFL Products reusable single cup coffee filter make one cup of coffee with coarse ground coffee beans or one cup of loose leaf tea using our 1 serve filters. Simply fill the mesh coffee filter with your coarse ground coffee or loose leaf tea, slide lid closed, tap to remove excess small pieces (so they don't end up in your cup), place in hot water and stir gently holding the handle until the drink is at the depth of flavor you like, remove and add milk or drink black. Simple great tasting filter coffee or tea in seconds instead of waiting for a long brew. Alternative to single serve coffee pods, k cup reusable filter and Keurig coffee machine filters. Reusable durable plastic and stainless steel mesh filter that can be used time and again, instead of throwing paper filters into landfill. Designed to be a small and compact filter to carry anywhere and store easily in a drawer, bag or box. A small coffee and tea maker no bigger than a spoon easy to clean and dishwasher safe.
